# Glossary {#sec-glossary}

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **As-of** | Computed only from information available before the game |
| **Ablation** | Adding (or removing) one feature family at a time to measure its contribution |
| **Break-even** | The win rate needed not to lose money: 52.38% at −110 |
| **CLV** (closing line value) | How far the line moved toward a pick between when it was taken and kickoff |
| **Closing / opening line** | The market's number at kickoff / when first posted |
| **Cover** | Winning against the spread: home covers when margin + spread > 0 |
| **Edge** | Model prediction minus the market's line, in points |
| **EPA / PPA** | Expected points added per play: efficiency above what a situation usually yields |
| **exp_points** | The ridge ratings' prediction for a team's points in a matchup |
| **FBS / FCS** | College football's top division / the division below |
| **Game script** | How the score shapes play: leaders run the clock, trailers pass and score late |
| **Leakage** | Using information from the future (or the outcome itself) in a feature |
| **MAE** | Mean absolute error, in points |
| **OOF** | Out-of-fold: predictions for rows the model didn't train on |
| **Push** | Exactly on the line; the stake is returned |
| **Ridge regression** | Linear regression with an L2 penalty that shrinks coefficients toward zero |
| **SHAP** | Attribution of a prediction to each feature (and pairs, for interactions) |
| **Shootout** | A game whose expected total is in the top 20% (above 63.5 points) |
| **Slate** | One (season, season type, week) |
| **Stacking** | Combining models with weights learned from their out-of-fold predictions |
| **Walk-forward CV** | Train on all seasons before N, validate on N, repeat for several N |
| **−110** | Standard price: risk 110 to win 100 |

: Terms used in this book. {#tbl-glossary}
